title: Pregnancy-Wise Leakage-Controlled Multi-Representation Fusion for Classifying Early- and Later-Recorded Electrohysterographic Recordings Using Wavelet Scalograms
description: Code associated with a pregnancy-wise leakage-controlled CNN–Transformer framework for classifying early- and later-recorded electrohysterographic recordings in ICEHG DS using S1, S2, S3, and RGB wavelet-scalogram representations and probability-level fusion. The endpoint is recording period, not preterm-birth prediction, delivery-outcome prediction, gestational-age estimation, or clinical diagnosis.
